voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: On Australia Day, nineteen sixty-six, three children caught the eight-forty-five bus to a beach in Adelaide.
Jane, nine. Arnna, seven. Grant, four.
They were seen on the beach with a tall, fair-haired man. They were never seen again.
Sixty years later, no bodies. No clothing. No trace. The parents kept the same phone number for decades, in case the children called.
Nancy died in twenty nineteen. Jim in twenty twenty-three. No one has ever been charged.
